unsupported_claims: Edge feature vectors were built from node embeddings using binary operators (Average, Hadamard, Weighted-L1, Weighted-L2).
A supervised binary classifier, logistic regression, was trained on the edge features.
The paper reports AUC and F1 results for link prediction.
